chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū al-Qāsim Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb al-Bajalī al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الْبَجَلِيِّ الْكُوفِيِّ: A pair of nisbahs identifying Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb as Bajalī and from Kūfah
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: A nisbah identifying Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā as al-ʿAṭṭār
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author's direct statement of transmission
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ: A transmitter from whom reports in this section are narrated

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits reports from Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the scholarly route through which these hadith reached the compiler.
